description: Search Polish public procurement entities (buyers / zamawiający) or contractors (wykonawcy) by name. Returns a list with NIP, location and volume. Useful to find the NIP for get_buyer / get_contractor tools.

query.description: Name (or fragment) of the entity to search, e.g. 'warszawa', 'gddkia', 'budimex'

type.description: Limit to buyers (zamawiający), contractors (wykonawcy), or both. Default: all

name: search_entities
title: Search procuring entities or contractors by name
